_what: The column rights tool:follow-a-short-link needs from a pursuit's writer login (run-sql-in-my-database role recipe may-write-named-columns-under-a-use, recipe.writes): the touch it follows, the click it keeps (do-work/journey.mjs keepStep, whose ON CONFLICT fills a kept step's missing fields), and the refs never to keep. test/follow-a-short-link.test.ts runs the tool as a login holding exactly these.
